headline: DSK Legal, Troutman Pepper Locke advise Energage on merger with Engagedly
sum: Energage, the human resources technology company behind the Top Workplaces employer recognition program, is merging with Engagedly Inc., an advanced AI-powered talent management platform. DSK Legal advised Energage on the India leg of the…
detail: Energage, the human resources technology company behind the Top Workplaces employer recognition program, is merging with Engagedly Inc., an advanced AI-powered talent management platform. DSK Legal advised Energage on the India leg of the merger. The Firm assisted in inter alia conducting due diligence on the Engagedly’s operations in India; review of the Merger Agreement; and assistance in closing of the transaction. Sameena Chatrapathy (Partner) was the relationship and lead engagement Partner for the transaction.
